```{r}
tmp = read_excel("../../../../Other_DS/Zhang_scRNA/All_markers_Epi_with_intestine_BBKNN.xlsx", sheet = 1)

tmp = subset(tmp, p_val_adj < 0.05 & avg_log2FC > 0.5)

sc_sets = split(tmp$gene, tmp$cluster)

```

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
all_ovlp = list()
sel_comparisons = c("IM_vs_non-IM_all_samples","IM_591_vs_NonIM","IM_592_vs_NonIM","IM_594_vs_NonIM","IM_all_vs_NormalAntrum","Colon_vs_NormalAntrum","Duodenum_vs_NormalAntrum")
fc_threshold = 0.5
for (n in sel_comparisons) {
  tmp = all_results[[n]]
  r_up = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange > fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  r_down = subset(tmp, padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -fc_threshold & !(GeneSymbol=="" | GeneSymbol=="NA"))
  
  for (gs in names(sc_sets)) {
    set_genes = sc_sets[[gs]]
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_UP_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_up$GeneSymbol)  
    all_ovlp[[paste0(n,"_DOWN_",gs)]] = intersect(set_genes, r_down$GeneSymbol)
    
    ll = list()
    ll[[gs]]=set_genes
    ll[[paste0(n,"_UP")]] = r_up$GeneSymbol
    ll[[paste0(n,"_DOWN")]] = r_down$GeneSymbol
    
    p = ggvenn(ll, set_name_size = 4) 
    print(p)
    
  }
}
  
  
```

# GSVA

```{r}
count_mat = as.matrix(norm_counts[,grepl("^X4", colnames(norm_counts))])
rownames(count_mat) <- norm_counts$GeneSymbol
res_gsva = gsva(count_mat, sc_sets)
#colnames(res_gsva) = ed[gsub("X","", colnames(res_gsva)), "Library.Name"]

col_anno = ed[gsub("^X", "", colnames(count_mat)), c("Patient","Condition")]
rownames(col_anno) = paste0("X", rownames(col_anno))

```

```{r, fig.width=10}

pheatmap(res_gsva, annotation_col = col_anno, labels_col = ed[gsub("^X", "", colnames(count_mat)), "Library.Name"])
```
